pr_title: Improve the way we receive the documents payload
pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #3037 

## What does this PR do?
- writing the playload to a temporary file via BufWritter
- deserialising the json tempporary file to an array of Objects by means of a memory map
- deserialising thie csv tempporary file by means of a memory map
- Adapted some read_json tests

Thank you so much for contributing to Meilisearch!

issue_context.title: Improve the way we receive the documents payload
issue_context.body:
We currently use the above-linked method to receive the documents payload sent by the users. This function stores everything into memory, this is not optimal, we could probably do much better and stream that to disk at least with [a `BufWriter` or equivalent](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/io/struct.BufWriter.html).

https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/9e189f5041fad0312fc0aa94038a890ad922e92c/meilisearch-http/src/routes/indexes/documents.rs#L197-L293
comments:
Hey @jiangbo212,

What you found looks interresting, storing the content into a temporary file and reading it using `serde_json` seems good to me. Would it be possible for you to open a PR? This way we will be able to test your changes and run the tests.

About the `http-payload-size` parameter, it should indicate the maximum size of a body in an HTTP request but I'm not sure if we must take the compression into account. Does it make any sense to measure it compressed or uncompressed?

review_comments: We need to only deserialize the `Object` and not the `Vec<Object>` type.
We need to rewrite this a little bit. There are too many uneeded `;`.
We need to rename this variant. There already is a `PayloadErr` part in the enum name.
